description: Old seed ID → new factory-published ID mapping for Grade 5 (Victorian Curriculum Level 5) questions originally authored in practiceQuestionSeeds (src/content/questions/generated/generated-questions.ts) and subsequently re-ingested through the question-factory pipeline and published to factoryPublishedQuestions (src/content/questions/generated/batch-published.json).
notes: Factory candidate IDs are minted fresh and immutable per the question-factory contract; the original seed ID is not reused as the published ID.

Only questions whose correctness is deterministically re-derivable (content/question-factory correctness dispatcher) reached difficulty_review_passed and were published without requiring the cross-provider semantic review gate.

The remaining 191 of the 195 original seeds have NOT been published: 190 are quarantined at the semantic review gate (semantic_objective / structurally_scoreable_only — require an independent second-model review via questions:review-ai, which cannot run in this environment because no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / QF_AI_PROVIDER is configured) and 1 (g5-alg-eq-002) was rejected by the correctness gate (declared_answer_mismatch — a real engine limitation on 'balance scale' equation phrasing, not a content error; the seed's declared answer is mathematically correct). These 191 remain in practiceQuestionSeeds only and are NOT part of the governed published bank; they have no entry below.

Curriculum alignments for the 4 migrated IDs have been updated in content/curriculum-imports/vic-f10-v2-l3-l5.json to reference the new published ID, but their review.status remains 'in_review' pending genuine Curriculum Review Board approval — they do not yet count toward gated coverage.

rejectedAtCorrectnessGate.reason: declared_answer_mismatch — deterministic arithmetic-expression extractor evaluates the balance-scale equation phrasing literally rather than solving for the unknown; declared answer is mathematically correct, this is a derive-answer.ts engine limitation, not a content defect.
